ledger: 00:00 - 8 spherical balls visible in the bowl (3 red, 3 yellow, 2 green).
00:04 - 8 spherical balls remain in the bowl.
00:05-00:09 - The objects in the bowl are mixed rapidly and appear as oval, egg-shaped objects rather than spheres.

findings.description: As the child begins to rapidly mix the contents of the bowl, the spherical balls transform into oval, egg-shaped objects (resembling plastic Easter eggs). There is no visible cause for this transformation of object type.
